objective: Add paired single-image defocus restoration to the official causal TURTLE model without letting unrelated single images write, reuse, or train its historical K/V pathway, while retaining ReplicaBlurry full-sequence history training.
interpretation_rule: DPDD single-image improvement is current-frame spatial restoration. A history claim additionally requires same-checkpoint persistent/reset/repeat/shuffled controls on real ordered video and an interaction against a non-video-trained checkpoint.

current_capabilities: hard K/V reset at every JSONL record
full-sequence BPTT or legacy one-frame truncation
all parameters or five history-attention modules

official_training_observation.optimizer_step: one backward after mean L1 over all five frames
official_training_observation.cache_boundary: reset for every sampled five-frame sequence

replica_video.cli_contract: --video-root is explicitly required for V/M; no implicit cwd or manifest-parent fallback

paired_single_image_defocus.decoded_format_contract: pixel-aligned 1680x1120 RGB 16-bit PNG blur/sharp pairs from a revision-pinned direct HuggingFace repository checkout
paired_single_image_defocus.decode_contract: cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED -> uint16 BGR2RGB -> float32 divide by 65535; PIL RGB8 conversion is forbidden
paired_single_image_defocus.canonical_line_schema: unblur_slam.dpdd_hf_canonical_pair.v1 with name, split, relative defocus, relative sharp, source_sha256, target_sha256
required_before_gpu: record HuggingFace repository identifier and immutable revision
verify exact split counts and zero path/content overlap
verify every pair has matching decoded dimensions and distinct files
materialize and pin dataset_manifest.json plus canonical train/validation manifest SHA256 values

keep test pixel bytes/decodes/metrics unopened until the terminal three-seed decision; filenames/LFS identifiers/sizes and prior limited URL/manifest metadata are already known and the split is not pristine

local_candidate_explicitly_rejected.reason: 34 multiview defocused observations plus downsampled copies and camera geometry; no aligned per-image sharp targets

forbidden_during_training_and_selection: DPDD test76 pixel bytes, decodes, or metrics; metadata is explicitly not pristine
TUM pose, depth, restoration, mapping, or trajectory metrics

sampling.source_schedule: one joint optimizer step contains DPDD backward first and Replica video backward second

video_sampler.shuffle: independent deterministic permutation per seed and pass

single_image_sampler.shuffle: one independent deterministic 350-image permutation per seed, then repeat its first 40 names in the same fixed order
single_image_sampler.coverage: all 350 train pairs exactly once plus 40 preregistered repeats; no validation-dependent resampling
single_image_sampler.augmentation: one random crop plus flips/quarter-turn per pair; blur and sharp share the exact transform
single_image_sampler.cache_rule: each image is independent; K=V=None and discarded after its one forward
single_image_sampler.two_frame_wrapper: pair=(current,current); the pinned model has use_both_input=false
single_image_sampler.decode: native RGB16 normalized by 65535 before the shared crop

sampling.no_batch_may_mix: pixels or K/V from unrelated Replica sequences or unrelated DPDD images

spatial_head.architectural_position: after all eight K/V outputs are produced; cannot write the cached tensors

fail_closed_checks: exact parameter names, tensor counts, and scalar counts
single-image backward produces no history gradients
one isolated single-image optimizer step leaves every history tensor byte-identical
video backward reaches at least one history tensor and one spatial-head tensor
AdamW skips parameters whose gradient is None

optimization.optimizer: one AdamW with separate history and spatial-head parameter groups

grad_scaler.overflow_policy: fail closed before scheduler advance and do not save a checkpoint

optimization.scheduler: cosine over 78 joint optimizer steps, eta_min=1e-7; history sees the same update count and LR trajectory in V and M
optimization.gradient_clipping: history and spatial head are clipped independently at norm 1.0; DPDD spatial gradients therefore cannot rescale the history gradient norm
mixed_step_order: freeze history and enable spatial head
DPDD batch5 forward and backward, accumulating spatial-head gradients
enable history and keep spatial head enabled
Replica full-sequence forward and backward, accumulating history plus spatial-head gradients
independent finite checks and norm-1 clipping for history and spatial groups
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed terminal only; no validation during training

video_step.supervision: frames 1..T-1; frame0 warms causal K/V without direct reconstruction loss
video_step.shuffle: cyclic left shift of the same complete strictly-past multiset

single_image_step.reason: an unrelated single image contains no valid temporal relation

bptt_and_cache.replica_video: full natural sequence BPTT; no K/V detach until one sequence-level backward; reset at record boundary
bptt_and_cache.dpdd_single_image: one forward only; K/V hard-reset before the image and output K/V immediately discarded

ablation_matrix.V: Replica video only, history plus spatial head, 78 video steps
ablation_matrix.S: DPDD single image only, spatial head only, 78 batches
ablation_matrix.M: mixed two-backward joint steps, each containing one DPDD batch5 and one Replica video sequence; 78 optimizer steps total

claim_accounting.single_image_spatial_delta: M.reset - V.reset on the same ordered video frames, plus M - V on DPDD where every pair has reset K/V
claim_accounting.within_checkpoint_past_presence: arm.normal - arm.reset and arm.normal - arm.repeat_current on steady video frames
claim_accounting.within_checkpoint_order_sensitivity: arm.normal - arm.shuffled on steady video frames
claim_accounting.prohibited_statement: M.normal - G.normal is a history gain
history_claim_requires: learned-history interaction PSNR at least 0.03 dB
same direction for every preregistered seed and both temporal validation sequences

dpdd_validation.resolution: native full-resolution RGB16 normalized by 65535, with deterministic right/bottom padding to multiple of 8 and crop-back
dpdd_validation.dataset_binding: dataset_manifest.json SHA -> canonical_manifests.validation path/SHA/74 -> the exact --manifest file
dpdd_validation.checkpoint_identity: G is byte-pinned official_gopro; V/S/M are distinct mixed-training.v3 checkpoints with exact arm, common seed, 78 attempted/executed updates, zero AMP skips, scaler contract, model/base pins, Replica/DPDD hashes, and paired-sharp/pose/depth flags

replica_temporal_validation.controls: all five same-checkpoint arms listed above

evaluation.dpdd_test: unconditionally rejected by this train-plus-validation exploratory protocol, including non-formal CLI calls and manifest-embedded split=test rows; metadata is not pristine and pixels/decodes/metrics remain unopened
evaluation.real_slam: TUM may be opened only after the restoration/history gates; report as a fixed-schedule downstream diagnostic, never tune on it

known_prior_result.interpretation: the official interface uses past state, but Replica-only fine-tuning did not establish additional useful order-sensitive history

blockers: DPDD-HF train/validation PNG16 bytes have not yet been materialized in the audited workspace
dataset_manifest.json and canonical train/validation SHA256 values therefore remain unknown
